Hi Marta / Ben — attaching the initial evidence set to this thread (see Drive link and filenames below). Short summary of what you'll find: 

- vm-scan-index-202709.xlsx: inventory of scan sources (Nessus, Trivy, SCA), scan frequency, and responsible owners.

High-level SLA attestation (for your intake) — Redwood Inference VM policy (summary):
- Critical (CVSS >=9): remediation aim = 7 days; emergency patching and compensating controls applied immediately.
- High (CVSS 7-8.9): remediation aim = 30 days.
- Medium (CVSS 4-6.9): remediation aim = 90 days with prioritization windows.
- Low (CVSS <4): remediation aim = 180 days or scheduled in maintenance windows.
